skip.gridspec: grid description files of the GFDL models (fx, no long name), not a variable

rluscs.note: 3hr: the metadata (long name, standard name, units) are those of rsuscs, the 3hr table has no rluscs, and INM-CM4 publishes all the other variables of the 3hr table but rsuscs

orograw.note: fx: the raw orography, as opposed to the surface altitude of the model (orog), also published

swit.note: 3hr: the soil wetness index of the ISBA land surface model (total_soil_wetness_index in the metadata, not a CF standard name)

lm.note: fx: land_sea_mask in the metadata (not a CF standard name), presumably the binary counterpart of sftlf (1 land, 0 sea; values not verified)

rtoa.note: AmonExtras: at the top of the atmosphere, unlike rtmt (at the top of the model)

pbp.note: OyrExtras: the phosphorus counterpart of pbfe and pbsi (Oyr); biogenic_phosphorus_production in the metadata is not a CF standard name, and the CF tendency_of_ocean_mole_content_of_phosphorus_due_to_biological_production is vertically integrated
